title: Pasta Aglio e Olio
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
Gently sauté sliced garlic in olive oil; add chili flakes.
Toss pasta with oil, splash pasta water, finish with parsley and salt.

title: Vegetable Omelette
steps: Sauté chopped onion, chili, tomato in a little oil.
Pour eggs, cook both sides until set.

title: Chickpea Salad
steps: Combine drained chickpeas with chopped veggies.
Dress with lemon juice and salt; toss to coat.
